edges.sentence: On 2026-10-01, Al Jazeera reported “Counter Terrorism police in the UK said on Thursday that a “27-year-old man, a dual UK/Iranian national, was arrested” in central London.”; on the same day, Deutsche Welle reported “Counter terrorism police said that a 27-year-old dual UK-Iranian national was arrested in London "on suspicion of preparation of terrorist acts under Section 5 of the Terrorism Act 2006."”.

On 2026-10-01, Al Jazeera reported “Counter Terrorism police in the UK said on Thursday that a “27-year-old man, a dual UK/Iranian national, was arrested” in central London.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “In the latest development, police said they had arrested the 27-year-old dual national in London”.

On 2026-10-01, Deutsche Welle reported “Counter terrorism police said that a 27-year-old dual UK-Iranian national was arrested in London "on suspicion of preparation of terrorist acts under Section 5 of the Terrorism Act 2006."”; on the same day, France 24 reported “In the latest development, police said they had arrested the 27-year-old dual national in London”.

On 2026-10-01, Al Jazeera reported “A second man, 26 – a UK national – was also “questioned under caution”, the police statement added.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “a second British man, 26, had also been questioned under caution”.

On 2026-10-01, Deutsche Welle reported “They said that a second man who is a UK national was also questioned under caution and that searches of two properties had taken place.”; on 2026-10-02, Al Jazeera reported “Police said they also conducted searches of two properties in the London area.”.
